root_cause.text: An off-by-one error in the whitespace-stripping loop of `init_card` in `sound/usb/caiaq/device.c` where the bounds check `len < sizeof(card->id)` does not reserve space for a null terminator, allowing the local `id` buffer to be fully filled with 16 characters and leaving it non-null-terminated, which later causes a stack out-of-bounds read when `snd_card_set_id()` scans past the end of the buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message explicitly state that `sizeof(card->id) == 16` and the local buffer is also 16 bytes, so writing 16 non-space characters overwrites the null terminator, leading to KASAN stack-out-of-bounds. The patch changes the bound to `sizeof(card->id) - 1` to ensure space for the null terminator.

intent_record.what: Changed loop condition from `len < sizeof(card->id)` to `len < sizeof(card->id) - 1` in the `init_card` function.
intent_record.how: This prevents the loop from writing a character at the last index of the `id` array, ensuring space remains for a null terminator, thus avoiding potential buffer overflow and guaranteeing proper null-termination of the string.
